issues.claim: Fitness Factory Health Club (120 Cedar Grove Lane) and Fitness Factory Franklin Park (3391 NJ-27) are 'locally run clubs' kept in the list
issues.problem: Fitness Factory is a multi-site New Jersey gym brand with its own branded club pages (fitnessfactorygym.com/somerset/, /franklin-park/) and an active franchise programme (franchise.vantage360fgp.com/fitness-factory, FDD-based unit economics, 2026 openings). That is a regional chain/franchise, which the mapper's own rules exclude (the same rules removed Crunch, Planet Fitness, LA Fitness).
issues.fix: Delete both Fitness Factory entries and note the exclusion in caveats; if any gym presence in the zone is wanted, look for a genuinely single-site club.

issues.claim: Luxi Nails & Spa V (Flagship Somerset), 441 Elizabeth Ave Suite 15, website somersetnailsnj.com
issues.problem: The cited website says the salon traded as Luxi Nails & Spa until it became Somerset Nails & Spa in 2024. The entry name is stale, and the note claims the site publishes 'eight consecutive years (2019-2026)' of Best Nail Salon awards - the About page I opened does not mention any awards, and a third-party profile dates the awards 2017-2022.
issues.fix: Rename to Somerset Nails & Spa (formerly Luxi Nails & Spa V), keep 441 Elizabeth Ave Suite 15 / 732-595-5200, and drop the awards sentence unless a current page states it.

issues.claim: Luxi Nails & Spa II, 456 Elizabeth Ave Suite 5 - website blank, phone 'Unknown'
issues.problem: The salon has its own site (luxinail.com) with a contact page giving 456 Elizabeth Avenue, Suite 5, Somerset 08873 and (732) 469-0099, plus online booking. Both fields were left empty.

issues.claim: Coverage gaps in categories the list claims to have swept
issues.problem: Independent verification found active eligible businesses missing from all four largest categories in the mapper's own source set: physical therapy (Back In Motion PT, 79 Veronica Ave, own website), barbershops (La Chispa Barbershop, 586 Hamilton St, 4.9/118 reviews on Booksy), hair salons (Salon NV, 3391 NJ-27 #111 Franklin Park; S Beauty Salon, 3151 NJ-27; Rounak Beauty Salon, 3201 NJ-27) and counselling (NJ Psychotherapy Counseling Center, 220 Davidson Ave Suite 306; Dr. Deborah Riviere, EdD, 107 Cedar Grove Lane Suite 104).
issues.fix: Add the seven businesses listed in coverage.missing before triage; sweep the Franklin Park/Route 27 beauty clusters and Psychology Today 08873 listings rather than only the Somerset BestProsInTown pages.

issues.problem: The practice's own site gives 1743 NJ-27, Suite 1 with (732) 249-0411 and identifies it as part of the KK Dental family - i.e. the same building and operator as the separate KK Dental Somerset entry. The listed phone comes from insurer directories only.
issues.fix: Use the practice's published number, add Suite 1, and cross-reference with the KK Dental entry so the two are not treated as unrelated prospects.

issues.claim: Hairtime Salon, 3191 NJ-27, Franklin Park - phone 'Unknown'
issues.problem: The salon's own location page (hairtime.us/franklin-park/contact-us/) publishes +1 732 419 3941 and the fuller address 3191 Lincoln Highway Route 27, Franklin Park 08823.
issues.fix: Fill the phone and street form of the address.

issues.claim: Luxi/awards aside, several entries still rest on one directory listing
issues.problem: Roughly 55 entries are single-directory (BestProsInTown, YellowPages, Superpages, Healthgrades) with no own website; I spot-checked four of them (Somerset Pediatric Dental Associates, Dental Design Group, Complete Dental Care, Somerset Family Dental-adjacent) and only the first two could be corroborated, so the tail of the list is unverified rather than wrong.
issues.fix: Before outreach, re-check the single-directory entries against a second independent source or an opened Google profile.
